column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 Diabolos and the lingering dead
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: This is the place where it all began: the $$約束の地$$, $$ディアボロス$$!
(I thought it was only a legendary place from myths!?)
There are p-people here, but something feels strange.
Yeah, something is strange. I can't sense a shred of life from them!?
Could those be the souls of people from long ago!?
Even in death, their souls have nowhere to go...
(Even after eons, this place remains exactly as it was then...)
